lines.raw: Claim scrubbing.
lines.say: Claim scrubbing.

lines.raw: A **claim scrubber** is software (in the billing system or at the clearinghouse) that checks each claim against thousands of rules before it is sent.
lines.say: A claim scrubber is software (in the billing system or at the clearinghouse) that checks each claim against thousands of rules before it is sent.

lines.raw: It is the provider's own copy of the checks the insurer will run, so errors are fixed **before** they cost time.
lines.say: It is the provider's own copy of the checks the insurer will run, so errors are fixed before they cost time.

lines.raw: Typical scrubber edits.
lines.say: Typical scrubber edits.

lines.raw: Missing or badly formed fields. Example it catches: No date of birth; member ID missing a suffix.
lines.say: Missing or badly formed fields. Example it catches: No date of birth; member I D missing a suffix.

lines.raw: Invalid codes. Example it catches: A deleted CPT code; a diagnosis code missing a required character.
lines.say: Invalid codes. Example it catches: A deleted C P T code; a diagnosis code missing a required character.

lines.raw: Code pairs. Example it catches: Two procedures that should not be billed together on the same day.
lines.say: Code pairs. Example it catches: Two procedures that should not be billed together on the same day.

lines.raw: Diagnosis supports procedure. Example it catches: A test billed with a diagnosis the insurer does not accept for it.
lines.say: Diagnosis supports procedure. Example it catches: A test billed with a diagnosis the insurer does not accept for it.

lines.raw: Payer-specific rules. Example it catches: This insurer wants a particular modifier or a referring doctor.
lines.say: Payer-specific rules. Example it catches: This insurer wants a particular modifier or a referring doctor.

lines.raw: Rejection vs denial.
lines.say: Rejection versus denial.

lines.raw: Here is a quick table.
lines.say: Here is a quick table.

lines.raw: **When**. Rejection: At intake, before the insurer decides anything. Denial: After the insurer has processed the claim.
lines.say: When. Rejection: At intake, before the insurer decides anything. Denial: After the insurer has processed the claim.

lines.raw: **Why**. Rejection: Format or data errors (bad ID, missing field). Denial: A decision: not covered, no approval, not medically necessary.
lines.say: Why. Rejection: Format or data errors (bad I D, missing field). Denial: A decision: not covered, no approval, not medically necessary.

lines.raw: **Where you see it**. Rejection: Acknowledgement files from the clearinghouse or insurer. Denial: The remittance (835), with a reason code.
lines.say: Where you see it. Rejection: Acknowledgement files from the clearinghouse or insurer. Denial: The remittance (8 35), with a reason code.

lines.raw: **What the provider does**. Rejection: Fix the data and send it again as a new claim. Denial: Correct and resubmit, or appeal (lesson 5).
lines.say: What the provider does. Rejection: Fix the data and send it again as a new claim. Denial: Correct and resubmit, or appeal (lesson 5).

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: A **claim scrubber** catches errors before the claim leaves, so they never cost a rejection or denial.
lines.say: A claim scrubber catches errors before the claim leaves, so they never cost a rejection or denial.

lines.raw: A **rejection** happens at intake and is fixed by resending; a **denial** is a decision made after processing.
lines.say: A rejection happens at intake and is fixed by resending; a denial is a decision made after processing.

lines.raw: Unpaid claims are tracked with **claim status checks** and **AR aging** buckets; older claims are harder to collect.
lines.say: Unpaid claims are tracked with claim status checks and A R aging buckets; older claims are harder to collect.

lines.raw: **Corrected claims** replace or void earlier versions, so one visit can have several claim records.
lines.say: Corrected claims replace or void earlier versions, so one visit can have several claim records.
